metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds seven heads, one meal at threepence, Anne's letter on the board, and Brooke still open.

yesterday: Master Thwaite stopped at seven heads and one turning of the glass.
You boarded at threepence. The loaf was short by a finger. The firing sixpence stayed running.
Anne's letter is still on the board.
Brooke is open. Tomorrow is the Bull.
